notes.title: A new look for HalalGoes
notes.body: Home, restaurants, your cart, orders and Account share one design. It follows your phone's light or dark setting and works with larger text.

notes.title: Halal certification you can read
notes.body: A restaurant page shows its halal certification details when we have them. How we check explains what we verify.

notes.title: Addresses and notifications in Account
notes.body: Save several addresses, choose where each order goes, and manage notifications from Account.
